missed.maker: Analog Devices (JLCPCB maker_label 'Analog Devices'); Texas Instruments for ISOUSB111 (JLCPCB 'Texas Instruments'); both allowlisted (S1)
missed.why: P2 did not consider this family: a USB repeater placed in series between the connector's D+/D- and USB_DP/USB_DM. The RP2354B's pins connect only to side 2, which is powered from the board's 3.3 V rail (3.201 to 3.399 V). A steady voltage on the connector's D+, such as the shared 5 V VBUS, reaches only side 1. So V12's steady limit rests on the side-2 driver, not on an OVP threshold. P2's 30 mV argument (an element that passes full-speed signalling passes 3.6 V) does not apply to this route. Figures read: (1) ADuM3160 datasheet, JLCPCB copy https://jlcpcb.com/api/file/downloadByFileSystemAccessId/8586196649656135680 (Chinese edition), read 2026-09-29T09:01:25Z, SHA-256 a874ef35...0a0f06. VDD2 3.1 to 3.6 V. Logic-high output VOH 2.8 V min, 3.6 V max (RL 15 kOhm), which is at or below 3.63 V. CIN 10 pF typ per pin. TA -40 to +105 C. Absolute maximum: VUD+/VUD- -0.5 V to VDD1 + 0.5 V, and VDD+/VDD- -0.5 V to VDD2 + 0.5 V. Upstream short-circuit protection is listed with no figure. ESD is HBM class 3A only, with no IEC 61000-4-2 rating. (2) ADuM4160 datasheet, JLCPCB copy https://jlcpcb.com/api/file/downloadByFileSystemAccessId/8586177548170903552, read 09:01:22Z, SHA-256 6d72c73d...c1e9: the same VOH 2.8 to 3.6 V, CIN 10 pF typ and VUD abs max VDDI + 0.5 V; TA -40 to +105 C. (3) ISOUSB111, SLLSFC6E rev. July 2025 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/isousb111.pdf, read 08:59:57Z, SHA-256 edd2f224...e0cefe). Bus pins UD+/UD-/DD+/DD- are rated -0.3 to 6 V for 1000 short events and 1000 h cumulative, so it survives a VBUS short, which the ADuM parts are not rated for. V3P3Vx 3.0 to 3.6 V. VOH 2.8 to 3.6 V. CIO 10 pF max. It detects speed and connection automatically. TA -40 to +125 C. HBM +/-2000 V only, and TI calls for external ESD diodes at the connector. JLCPCB exact matches: ADuM3160BRWZ-RL stock 5068, presale 4946, 5.6595 USD at 1 (09:01:11Z). ADuM4160BRWZ-RL stock 5531, presale 5334, 9.7514 USD (09:01:10Z). ISOUSB111DWR stock 33, presale 25 (09:01:07Z), which fails rule 4. ISOUSB111DWXR stock 0, presale -179 (09:01:08Z). Not shown, so Digi-Key was not read: (a) V9 and the V12 clamp still need a connector-side array. VBUS54CV-HSF covers VBUS plus 4 lines at +/-30 kV contact and air, but it gives VC 22 V max at 11 A 8/20 us, not a 16 A TLP figure (Document 84145 Rev. 1.3, https://www.vishay.com/docs/84145/vbus54cvhsf.pdf, read 09:00:44Z, SHA-256 26a39d9a...04fd08). (b) Soft-connect and BOOTSEL re-enumeration of the RP2354B through the repeater are not shown. (c) The ADuM upstream pins exceed their rating under a steady 5 V on D+. The re-rank qualifies the set.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: No VBUS pin or CC/SBU only: fail 'lines covered'; SBU OVP 4.35 V min fails V12; TPD2S300 and TCPP01/02: not qualified, datasheets not read, no steady 3.63 V limit on D+/D- shown
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: V12 governs only USB_DP and USB_DM (QFN-80 pins 66 and 67). V13 sets 5 lines that the protection covers, not one package. A CC-only part therefore fails neither V12 nor 'lines covered' as the CC1/CC2 element of a set. TPD2S300 has no D+/D- pins. SLVSDL1 (https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tpd2s300.pdf, read 2026-09-29T08:59:08Z, SHA-256 d1f89a59...fd53c04) gives 2 channels of CC1/CC2 short-to-VBUS OVP, 24 V DC tolerant, and VOVPCC_RISE 5.55 V min, 6.18 V max. It also gives IEC 61000-4-2 +/-8 kV contact and +/-15 kV air on CC1/CC2, TA -40 to 85 C, and integrated dead-battery Rd. The reason given for it does not apply. For TCPP01-M12 and TCPP02-M18, 'datasheets not read' is not a failed requirement value, and they were not read in this task either. The SBU-OVP reason for TPD4S311 and TPD6S300 concerns SBU, not D+/D-. This changes no ranking by itself: the function still needs a D+/D- element that meets V12, such as the isolator route under missed.
